scheme_name: Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna
other_conditions: Bride must be above 18 years of age
Groom must be above 21 years of age
Both bride and groom must be unmarried
Marriages must be registered according to applicable rules
benefits_summary: A total grant of ₹25,000 per couple, with ₹21,000 allotted to the bride and ₹4,000 to the marriage organizer.
documents_required: Certified list of the couples involved in the solemnized marriage
Attested copies of marriage registration certificates
Hard copies of the documents uploaded at the time of application
